specs.Compatible Phone Models: Compatible with iOS and Android devices

features: 【Daily Activity Tracking & Step Counter】Track your steps, calories burned, and distance walked every day with this smart fitness tracker. The band records and displays your activity history so you can meet your fitness goals. Whether you're walking, running, or going about your day, this band ensures every move is logged for improved health outcomes.

【Bluetooth Call & Message Support】This smart fitness band allows seamless Bluetooth connectivity with your smartphone, enabling you to receive, reject, and manage calls directly from your wrist. You can also read messages from WhatsApp, Facebook, and SMS. For full functionality, download the companion app on your Android or iOS device and stay connected without picking up your phone

【User-Friendly Design】The smart band offers extended battery life, lasting several days on a single charge, depending on usage. With its sleek, lightweight, and ergonomic design, it's comfortable to wear all day and night. The band is also sweat-resistant, making it suitable for workouts, outdoor activities, and everyday wear.

【Heart Rate & Blood Pressure Monitoring】Keep track of your heart health and blood pressure levels with real-time monitoring. The band features an advanced optical sensor that accurately measures heart rate and blood pressure throughout the day. It helps users maintain awareness of their physical state, perfect for fitness enthusiasts and health-conscious individuals.
